items.name: Default
items.summary: Basic button group for organizing related actions into a unified control with connected visual appearance.

items.name: SingleSelect
items.template:
<nve-button-group behavior-select="single">
  <nve-icon-button pressed container="flat" icon-name="bars-3-bottom-left"></nve-icon-button>
  <nve-icon-button container="flat" icon-name="bars-3-bottom-right"></nve-icon-button>
  <nve-icon-button container="flat" icon-name="bars-4"></nve-icon-button>
</nve-button-group>
items.summary: Button group with single selection behavior for mutually exclusive options like view modes or formatting.

items.name: MultiSelect
items.template:
<nve-button-group behavior-select="multi">
  <nve-icon-button pressed container="flat" icon-name="bold" size="sm"></nve-icon-button>
  <nve-icon-button container="flat" icon-name="italic" size="sm"></nve-icon-button>
  <nve-icon-button pressed container="flat" icon-name="strikethrough" size="sm"></nve-icon-button>
</nve-button-group>
items.summary: Button group with multi-selection behavior for toggling many options simultaneously like text formatting.

items.name: Disabled
items.template:
<nve-button-group container="rounded">
  <nve-button disabled>button</nve-button>
  <nve-divider orientation="vertical"></nve-divider>
  <nve-icon-button icon-name="caret" size="sm" direction="down" disabled></nve-icon-button>
</nve-button-group>
items.summary: Button group in disabled state for indicating unavailable actions or read-only contexts.

items.name: Flat
items.summary: Button group with flat container styling for minimal visual appearance and reduced emphasis.

items.name: Action
items.summary: Button group for clustering related action buttons with cohesive visual treatment.

items.name: ActionSplit
items.template: button button button
items.summary: Split button groups with different interaction styles for primary actions with dropdown alternatives.

items.name: ActionSplitRounded
items.template: button button button
items.summary: Split button groups with rounded container styling for softer visual appearance and modern aesthetics.

items.name: Rounded
items.template:
<nve-button-group container="rounded" behavior-select="single">
  <nve-button pressed>All Time</nve-button>
  <nve-button>30 Days</nve-button>
  <nve-button>90 Days</nve-button>
</nve-button-group>
items.summary: Rounded button group with single selection for segmented controls and filter options with pill-style buttons.

items.name: RoundedIcon
items.summary: Rounded button group with icon buttons for compact view switchers and mode toggles.

items.name: OrientationVertical
items.summary: Button group with vertical orientation for sidebars, toolbars, or vertical navigation contexts.
